messages:
Evan (Docs): opened a tiny PR to replace 'tenant id' language in audit export examples with safer phrasing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/611
Rina (Security): thanks. please use 'tenant identifier (non-reversible pseudonym)'. avoid any wording that implies we can map it back to a person.
Tom (Eng): the python snippet also used param name 'tenant_id' which is outdated. suggested change: `tenant_identifier="nrp-42"` so customers copy-paste works.
Evan (Docs): can you paste the minimal py + curl snippets so I can drop them into the PR?
Tom (Eng): python: `from redwood.audit import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
for row in client.export_rows(scope="tenant", tenant_identifier="nrp-42", format="jsonl"):
    print(row)`
Tom (Eng): curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/audit/exports?scope=tenant&tenant_identifier=nrp-42" -o tenant-export.jsonl`
Priya (Legal): wording fine. add sentence: "Exports are subject to configured retention periods unless placed on legal hold." keeps SOC2 compliance clarity.
Rina (Security): also add pointer to log-redaction docs and note that exported rows may omit or redact sensitive request fields. link: /docs/security/log-redaction
DocsBot: PR 611 - docs CI queued
Evan (Docs): thanks all 44d I'll update the PR text and merge after CI if green.
Tom (Eng): lgtm
Priya (Legal): lgtm
Rina (Security): lgtm
